UPDATE label_data_entry e JOIN (SELECT a.entry_id AS entryId, COUNT(DISTINCT a.review_status) AS reviewKinds, MIN(a.review_status) AS reviewValue, COUNT(DISTINCT a.label_status) AS labelKinds, MIN(a.label_status) AS labelValue, MAX(a.reject_count) AS rejectValue, MAX(a.review_round) AS roundValue, MIN(a.reviewer_id) AS reviewerValue, MAX(a.review_time) AS reviewTimeValue FROM label_asset a JOIN label_job_asset ja ON ja.asset_id = a.id WHERE ja.job_id = #{jobId} AND a.deleted = 0 AND a.entry_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.entry_id) s ON s.entryId = e.id SET e.review_status = CASE WHEN s.reviewKinds = 1 THEN s.reviewValue ELSE e.review_status END, e.label_status = CASE WHEN s.labelKinds = 1 THEN s.labelValue ELSE e.label_status END, e.reject_count = IFNULL(s.rejectValue, e.reject_count), e.review_round = GREATEST(IFNULL(s.roundValue, 0), IFNULL(e.review_round, 0)), e.reviewer_id = s.reviewerValue, e.review_time = s.reviewTimeValue, e.updated_by = #{userId}, e.update_time = NOW() WHERE e.deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT rr.id, rr.job_id AS jobId, COALESCE(u.nick_name, u.user_name, '未知') AS reviewerName, rr.review_type AS reviewType, rr.result, rr.problem_type AS problemType, rr.problem_level AS problemLevel, rr.comment, rr.create_time AS createTime FROM label_review_record rr LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = rr.reviewer_id WHERE rr.deleted = 0 AND (rr.entry_id = #{assetId} OR rr.asset_id = #{assetId}) ORDER BY rr.id DESC
